model_implementation_gate: No neural model implementation or training may begin until E0.12 validates this contract, the frozen splits, the trace schemas, and all eight manipulation paths.

comparison_arms.architecture: shared encoder, four non-recurrent reasoning blocks, shared decoder
shared encoder, one weight-tied recurrent core, shared decoder
shared encoder, high-level macro core plus weight-tied low-level micro core, shared decoder

depth_protocol.input_recall: reinject the immutable problem hash and complete validated evidence bundle before every macro and micro recurrence
depth_protocol.gradient_truncation: full backpropagation through every sampled training unroll; detach only between examples

registered_negative_controls: train at one fixed loop count
remove the executable external halting gate
evaluate beyond the common training depth
provide a stale or incompatible memory artifact

decision_tree.hierarchical_wins: adopt the hierarchical core and proceed to a separately contracted native-working-memory milestone
decision_tree.flat_wins: adopt the flat recurrent core and reject hierarchy as unevidenced complexity
decision_tree.fixed_depth_wins: stop recurrent development and retain fixed depth
decision_tree.recurrence_requires_more_flops: classify the result as test-time scaling rather than architectural efficiency
decision_tree.one_family_only: retain recurrence only as a specialized reasoner
decision_tree.memory_contract_failure: block promotion regardless of task accuracy
decision_tree.manipulation_failure: invalidate the experiment and repair the assay

mechanisms.name: compute-, parameter-, data-, and interface-matched three-arm comparison
authoritative_inputs: one maximum inference FLOP and evidence-operation budget
outputs: per-arm parameter, data exposure, FLOP, retrieval, and tool accounting
assumptions: the encoder and decoder are byte-identical across arms
a parameter spread below one percent is materially matched at this prototype scale
unused inference budget is recorded rather than silently reallocated
mechanisms.scope: fixed-depth, flat recurrent, and high/low recurrent reasoners only
mechanisms.cost: constant-time configuration audit plus per-run compute accounting
mechanisms.tradeoff: strict matching may leave a small amount of capacity unused in one arm
mechanisms.failure_response: invalidate the comparison before training and repair the mismatched configuration
permitted_mutations: write a new versioned arm configuration before the first training run
kill_criteria: C1: parameter counts differ by more than one percent
C2: maximum inference FLOPs differ at all
C3: encoder, decoder, data, evidence interface, or optimizer budget identifiers differ
C4: retrieval or tool-call budgets differ
C5: one arm sees a different example, split, seed, or update count

mechanisms.name: frontier-bound recurrent input, high/low state, and output interface
authoritative_inputs: validated stamped retrieval, analytic, and graph evidence references
outputs: executed macro/micro counts and immutable trace
assumptions: recurrent state is working state and never evidence authority
the original problem and complete evidence bundle are reinjected and revalidated at every recurrence
every durable answer names its input and evidence frontier
mechanisms.scope: single-example recurrent execution; no native neural memory writes
mechanisms.cost: one problem/evidence hash check and compatibility validation per recurrent step
mechanisms.failure_response: mark the trace invalid and block the output
permitted_mutations: append immutable reasoning and evidence-operation journal records
kill_criteria: I1: a trace step changes the immutable problem representation
I2: a step omits or substitutes a stamped evidence view
I3: recurrent state is cited as independent evidence
I4: an output lacks unresolved residuals, halt reason, or exact step counts
I5: an evidence/tool operation returns without an immutable journal identifier

mechanisms.name: randomized training depth and unseen-depth evaluation protocol
assumptions: all sampled training unrolls use full backpropagation
unseen evaluation depths are never sampled during training
fixed-depth and fixed-loop-count controls share the same data
mechanisms.scope: training macro depths one through four; evaluation through twelve
mechanisms.cost: up to twelve macro steps and forty-eight micro steps per evaluation example
mechanisms.tradeoff: random depth increases gradient variance but tests depth extrapolation directly
mechanisms.failure_response: strengthen randomization and early exit once; reject recurrence if the registered repair still fails
permitted_mutations: register one repaired depth protocol before a rematch
kill_criteria: D1: training uses only one loop count outside the fixed-loop manipulation arm
D2: unseen-depth examples leak into training
D3: performance peaks at the training depth and falls beyond the one-point tolerance
D4: extra allowed loops reduce accuracy by more than one point
D5: the input/evidence recall path is absent at any recurrence

mechanisms.name: learned decision gated by executable external residual
authoritative_inputs: unanswered, missing, conflicting, and postcondition residuals
outputs: continue, resolved halt, or unresolved-budget halt
assumptions: a learned stop cannot override a non-empty executable residual
a learned continue remains active even when the residual is empty
the hard budget always terminates execution
mechanisms.scope: reasoner control flow; no task-answer scoring inside the learned halt head
mechanisms.cost: constant-time residual evaluation per recurrent step
mechanisms.tradeoff: conservative residuals may spend more compute than the learned policy requests
mechanisms.failure_response: force another cycle while budget remains; otherwise return unresolved
permitted_mutations: append one halt decision to the immutable trace
kill_criteria: H1: learned stop halts while an external residual remains
H2: execution exceeds the hard macro, micro, FLOP, retrieval, or tool budget
H3: adaptive halting saves less than twenty percent median compute
H4: adaptive halting loses more than one point of accuracy
H5: learned and external decisions cannot be forced to disagree in manipulation checks

mechanisms.name: frozen three-family recurrence assay
authoritative_inputs: deterministic task generator version and split seeds
frozen train, in-distribution, and out-of-distribution content hashes
held-out lengths, graph structures, and multiview compositions
assumptions: OOD means unseen length, structure, or composition rather than a new draw from the training generator
the task generator is deterministic under its registered seed
a headline result is invalid if any manipulation path fails to fire
mechanisms.scope: algorithmic checksum, graph shortest-path, and multiview memory composition tasks
mechanisms.cost: full three-arm runs over five paired seeds plus all ablations
mechanisms.tradeoff: small synthetic families isolate mechanism behavior but do not establish general reasoning
mechanisms.failure_response: repair and re-freeze the assay before interpreting model performance
permitted_mutations: write a new versioned split registry before any model sees it
kill_criteria: A1: a frozen split content hash changes
A2: OOD lengths, structures, or compositions overlap their training axis
A3: any manipulation fails to change its intended gate or input
A4: a protected region is absent from task evidence or scoring
A5: a stale, incompatible, or tombstoned evidence reference reaches a reasoner
A6: metrics are pooled without per-family, per-depth, and per-region readings

mechanisms.name: falsifiable recurrent-core promotion gate
authoritative_inputs: paired-seed ID/OOD accuracy and compute metrics
outputs: adopt hierarchy, adopt flat recurrence, retain fixed depth, or specialize
blocked promotion on any memory-contract or assay failure
assumptions: paired confidence intervals use the same seeds and examples across arms
accuracy and compute promotion criteria are conjunctive
mechanisms.scope: promotion of a recurrent reasoner architecture only; no autonomous deployment
mechanisms.cost: one deterministic promotion audit over recorded metrics
mechanisms.tradeoff: strict non-inferiority can reject a narrow but useful recurrent specialist
mechanisms.failure_response: follow the registered decision tree and preserve the losing runs
permitted_mutations: record a human-approved architecture decision after the executable gate
kill_criteria: P1: recurrent OOD improvement has a non-positive 95 percent lower confidence bound
P2: recurrence regresses ID or any protected region by more than two points
P3: additional allowed loops reduce accuracy by more than one point
P4: adaptive halting misses either its twenty-percent saving or one-point accuracy tolerance
P5: any evidence/tool operation is unjournaled or uses invalid memory
P6: hierarchy wins no family or regresses another by more than two points
P7: the comparison or any manipulation control is invalid
